title: BounceBack
description: TP You at 200 blocks if you take a damage
body:
# 💥 BounceBack - Get Launched When You Take Damage!

BounceBack is a fun little datapack that sends players flying 100 blocks into the air every time they take damage.
Great for Minecraft challenges, chaotic survival moments, or just messing around with friends 😈
# 🧠 How it works

Every time a player takes damage (from mobs, lava, fall, etc.), they're immediately launched sky-high 🚀
It’s simple, lightweight, and doesn’t require any mods or setup — just drop it in your world’s datapacks folder and go!

# 📦 Features

    - ⛏ Works in singleplayer and multiplayer

    - 🚀 Launches you up 100 blocks on hit

    - 🎇 Particles and sound effects for extra style

    - 🔧 Easily customizable (change height, effects, etc.)

# 📺 Content creators

If you're using this datapack in a YouTube video or challenge, please credit me and include a link to this page 🙏

# 🛠 Installation

    - Download the .zip

    - Put it in .../.minecraft/saves/YourWorld/datapacks/

    - Enter your world and run /reload if needed

    - Done!
